items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: Class-name merge for Marquee parts: clsx plus tailwind-merge, extended with the token namespaces tailwind-merge cannot know about.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The house button: the offset block, its rounded twin, an outline, a destructive two-tap and a ghost.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: the quiet raised slab at rest, the primary fill and the lift shadow when pressed, drawn from aria-pressed.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: The house field: the 44px floor, the 2px line and the action colour on focus.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The house field, multi-line: Input's own string plus the vertical pad that starts the first line where an Input puts its text.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label, plus the mono micro-caps section label as a tone.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: The term/detail cell as a real dl: groups the content model allows and nothing else, so a link or a hint lands inside the value rather than beside it. No asChild - HTML fixes all four elements.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A field as the wiring between its label, control, description and message: one generated id, htmlFor, aria-describedby naming only the parts that rendered, and aria-invalid. No form library.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The house surface, as parts: header, title, description, content, footer.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A yes/no as parts: a 44px label row, a native checkbox drawn as an invisible overlay on it, and a box whose mark is painted by the platform's own :checked.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice out of several, as parts: the group owns the shared name, each row is a 44px label over a native radio, and the roving tab stop and the arrow keys come from the platform.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A boxed notice as parts, in five tones, leaving the live-region role to the caller.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A circular image with an optional corner mark, as parts: the caller owns the box and the image fills it.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A status token in mono micro-caps, in four tones.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule at the house line weight, in either orientation.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Disclosure as four parts over Radix Accordion. No icon: the trigger is a slot.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A bottom sheet on mobile and a centred dialog from 768 up, with a real scroll region.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A boolean control as parts: a 44px row, a track and a thumb, drawn from the platform's own state on either a button or a native checkbox.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One transient toast, portalled to a body-level stack, dismissing itself after six seconds.

items.name: ribbon
items.title: Ribbon
items.description: The tilted marquee band: two identical halves, a seamless loop, a pace that scales with the copy.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The trail of where you are, as parts: one line always, where only the step you are standing on may give way and every linked step keeps its whole tap band.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbered pages as plain anchors, crawlable with no scripts: one cell per page, 44px on both axes, and one prop deciding the current page's ink and its announcement together.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Composable Select parts with Radix keyboard and state behavior.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Composable Tabs parts with Radix keyboard and state behavior.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A centered, scrollable dialog with explicit portal, overlay and close parts. Radix owns modal focus and dismissal; the caller owns content and saving.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A composed confirmation with Cancel initial focus, blocked outside dismissal, and caller-controlled closing. Portal, overlay and actions are explicit.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An anchored panel with explicit parts, caller-owned labels and optional modal focus.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Supplemental noninteractive text with explicit provider, portal and arrow. Radix owns focus, hover and collision placement; actions retain independent accessible names.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: Explicit action menu parts with checkboxes, radio choices and directional submenus. Default modal; portals, indicators, arrows and chevrons belong to the caller.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Numeric values and ranges with explicit track, range and independently named thumbs. Radix owns keyboard, pointer, direction and form reset; controlled callers accept reset changes.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Unreleased candidate. Inline single, multiple-date and range selection with caller-owned state and replaceable calendar slots.
